svg.title: Relativity of simultaneity
svg.desc: Two emissions at opposite ends of a train occur at the same train-frame coordinate time. Lorentz-transformed event coordinates give different ground-frame times, distinct from signal-arrival delays. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: The same two emissions need not be simultaneous
The lamps emit at t′ = 0 at x′ = ±L0/2. Lorentz transformation gives ground times ±γvL0/(2c²). These
are synchronized-clock coordinates, not light-arrival delays.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
